chapters.reason: HGRN2 is a linear-state recurrent model that uses a matrix-valued hidden state and predetermined algebraic update rules to achieve efficient inference.

The paper focuses on improving the expressiveness of recurrent models by replacing standard attention mechanisms with linear-state mixers, which is a core aspect of transformer-to-RNN conversion research.
The paper discusses hardware-efficient training and linear attention interpretations, which align with the goals of compressive memory and efficient streaming architectures.
